import unittest

from solution import run_pipeline


class RunPipelineTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_order_and_stage_chaining(self):
        seen = []

        def first(item):
            seen.append(("first", item["value"]))
            item["value"] += 1
            return item

        def second(item):
            seen.append(("second", item["value"]))
            return {"value": item["value"] * 10}

        items = [{"value": 1}, {"value": 3}]
        self.assertEqual(run_pipeline(items, [first, second]), [{"value": 20}, {"value": 40}])
        self.assertEqual(seen, [("first", 1), ("second", 2), ("first", 3), ("second", 4)])
        self.assertEqual(items, [{"value": 1}, {"value": 3}])

    def test_mutating_stage_cannot_mutate_nested_input(self):
        items = [{"nested": {"values": [1]}}]

        def mutate(item):
            item["nested"]["values"].append(2)
            return item

        result = run_pipeline(items, [mutate])
        self.assertEqual(result, [{"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}}])
        self.assertEqual(items, [{"nested": {"values": [1]}}])

    def test_stage_values_results_and_separate_results_are_isolated(self):
        shared = {"values": []}
        captured = []

        def produce(item):
            item["payload"] = shared
            captured.append(item)
            return item

        results = run_pipeline([{}, {}], [produce])
        shared["values"].append("external")
        captured[0]["payload"]["values"].append("captured")
        self.assertEqual(results, [
            {"payload": {"values": []}},
            {"payload": {"values": []}},
        ])
        results[0]["payload"]["values"].append("first")
        self.assertEqual(results[1], {"payload": {"values": []}})

    def test_no_stages_still_deep_copies(self):
        nested = {"values": [1]}
        items = [{"x": nested}, {"x": nested}]
        results = run_pipeline(items, ())
        self.assertEqual(results, items)
        self.assertIsNot(results[0]["x"], nested)
        self.assertIsNot(results[0]["x"], results[1]["x"])
        results[0]["x"]["values"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(items[0]["x"]["values"], [1])
        self.assertEqual(results[1]["x"]["values"], [1])

    def test_empty_inputs(self):
        self.assertEqual(run_pipeline([], []), [])
        self.assertEqual(run_pipeline((), (lambda value: value,)), [])

    def test_invalid_arguments_and_stage_results(self):
        for items in (None, {}, "items"):
            with self.subTest(items=items), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                run_pipeline(items, [])
        for stages in (None, {}, "stages"):
            with self.subTest(stages=stages), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                run_pipeline([], stages)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            run_pipeline([{} , 1], [])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            run_pipeline([{}], [None])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            run_pipeline([{}], [lambda item: []])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
